test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: **Out of the following four options, choose the incorrect sentence: **

options.text: Our products is more expensive than other products.
Our products are less expensive than other products.
All the other products are more expensive than ours.
We are selling our products cheaper than others.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Our products is more expensive than other products.**"
